A '''skirmish over Ylesia''' took place around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] battled with the insurgent forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. During the battle, the Rebels captured the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. The ''Salvation'' was later placed under the command of Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].<ref name="TFU2n" />
